dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline along the trailing edge, exhibiting a moderate falcate curvature from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a wide pixel radius, lacking acute angularity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50-degree anterior margin steepness relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Estimated 1.4:1 ratio of maximum horizontal base width to vertical apex height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large-radius convex curve defining a prominent, bulbous melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak protrusion with a low length-to-depth pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the clearly defined crease where the melon curvature terminates and the rostrum begins.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent elliptical light-colored patch situated on the dorsal-lateral surface of the caudal peduncle.
